Series overview states fan cooling; ordering table defines N as Normal and R as Reverse airflow. For the exact NA identity, normal is a printed option label; connector-to-connector direction is not stated on these pages. [PDF p. 2, 9]
Printed small form factor: 321.5 × 54.5 × 40 mm (12.66 × 2.14 × 1.57 in); dimension order preserved without assigning unprinted axes. [PDF p. 1]
Always-On 16.5 W programmable standby output (3.3/5 V) is a series feature; it is not an instruction to sum rail maxima. [PDF p. 1]

Figure 20 for PFE1100-12-054NA shows nominal main-output current derating dependent on AC input voltage and ambient temperature. Prose says current limitation decreases above 45°C inlet ambient or when AC input is too low, and actual V1 current limitation begins approximately 4 A above Figure 20. No graph points are digitized or transferred from the separate RA Figure 21. [PDF p. 9]

Main output V1 nominal voltage 12.0 VDC; nominal output power 1080 W and nominal output current 90.0 ADC at V1 = 12 VDC. Table general condition Ta = 0 … +45 °C unless otherwise noted; these are not current-limitation thresholds. [PDF p. 5]
Normal-airflow standby nominal ratings: 3.3 VDC, 16.5 W, 5 ADC; or 5.0 VDC, 16.5 W, 3.3 ADC. Table general condition Ta = 0 … +45 °C unless otherwise noted. [PDF p. 5]
PFE1100-12-054xA series is described as a 1100 Watt AC to DC power supply with 12 VDC main output; this class description is distinct from the nominal main-output table rating. [PDF p. 1]
Series wide input voltage range: 90–264 VAC; output derating applies at low input voltage/raised ambient temperature. [PDF p. 1, 9]
Canada/United States, NAC-listed model group, 100–200 VAC input: 83.4–125 A at 45°C; 69–104 A at 60°C. These are linear derating ranges, not a constant rating at every input voltage. [PDF p. 4]
Canada/United States, NAC-listed model group, 200–240 VAC or 200–350 VDC input: 125 A at 45°C; 104 A at 60°C. [PDF p. 4]

Countries other than Canada/United States, NAC-listed model group, 100–200 VAC input: 66.5–125 A at 45°C; 66.5–104 A at 60°C. These are linear derating ranges, not a constant rating at every input voltage. [PDF p. 4]
Countries other than Canada/United States, NAC-listed model group, 200–240 VAC or 200–350 VDC input: 125 A at 45°C; 104 A at 60°C. [PDF p. 4]

For model groups explicitly including PFE1500-12-054NAC, main output V1 = 12.0 V; output derates linearly as ambient increases 45°C → 60°C and input voltage decreases 200 VAC → 100 VAC. Regional tables remain separate. [PDF p. 4]
Certificate rated AC input for listed model group including NAC: 100–240 V ~, 12–7 A, 50/60 Hz. [PDF p. 1]
Certificate rated output for listed model group including NAC: V1 12.0 Vdc, 125 A; Vsb alternatives 5 Vdc, 3.3 A / 3.3 Vdc, 5 A. [PDF p. 1]

V1 maximum output power is de-rated at different input voltages and operating ambient temperatures; certificate directs the reader to Conditions of Acceptability. It does not establish 125 A at every operating condition. [PDF p. 1]
N Normal Airflow from Output connector to Input AC socket; the exact PFE1500-12-054NAC ordering row is under that normal-airflow footnote. [PDF p. 2]
Exact PFE1500-12-054NAC ordering row: C16 AC input connector; input range 180 VDC ~ 350 VDC and 90 VAC ~ 264 VAC. These operating ranges are distinct from certificate rated-input ranges. [PDF p. 2]
Upper standard ordering group has programmable 3.3/5 V standby; lower S412 12 VSB models are separate and excluded from this NAC statement. [PDF p. 2]

Attached storage: one to six chains; each chain contains up to six HDD-only or SSD-capable disk shelves, combined in any order. No shelf/cable model or wiring topology is stated here. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-6D3F47EA-7D39-46CC-B484-3CC3BF6671DB; article paragraphs 1]

Fan-module fault indications: front/rear Service Action Required LEDs, front Fan Module Service Action Required (TOP) LED, and Fan Fault LED on/adjacent to faulty module. System Overtemp LED might also light if temperature rises. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 37,39,40,41,42]

Two fan power boards are FRUs; power fan modules, carry status LEDs and transfer I2C fan-module data. Two refers to boards, not fan-module quantity. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 19]

Documented configuration/cluster rule in dated OS8.8.x manual, not installed-unit inventory: Two system boot drives in slots 0 and 1 form a mirrored pair; up to four read-optimized cache SSDs can populate slots 2–5 in order. In a Sun ZFS Storage 7420 clustered configuration, both controllers SSD counts must match. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 22]

Six-drive backplane is a FRU with drive connectors, I/O-board interconnect, Power/Locator buttons and status LEDs; this is not an installed-drive count. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 20]

Vertical PDB Card, also called vertical power distribution board or Paddle Card, is a FRU interconnecting PDB with fan power boards, hard-drive backplane and I/O board. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 17]

Power Distribution Board is a FRU: distributes main 12V from supplies; connects to Vertical PDB, motherboard bus bar/ribbon cable and top-cover interlock kill switch. power supplies → power supply backplane → power distribution board topology is explicitly described. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 16]

Power Supply Backplane Card connects the PDB to power supplies 0 and 1. These are named connection positions; no PSU model, rating or redundancy inference is supplied. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 18]

SP subsystem controls host power and monitors host events. SP controller uses host 3.3V standby rail whenever AC input is present, even when system is off. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 15]

Documented configuration/cluster rule in dated OS8.8.x manual, not installed-unit inventory: Two system boot drives in slots 0 and 1 form a mirrored pair; up to four read-optimized cache SSDs can populate slots 2–5 in order. In a Sun ZFS Storage 7420 M2 clustered configuration, each controller SSD count can vary. [HTML #ZFSRE-GUID-23D9E421-97EA-4692-B197-0F5E78A142A3; article paragraphs 21]
